meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码结构搜索并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要跨文件修改同一类代码结构。
copy.tagline_en: Search code by syntax shape and rewrite it in bulk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to modify the same kind of code structure across files.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按代码结构(而非纯文本)查找和改写代码。它能找出形状相同的函数、调用、类等,并批量替换,比如把所有 console.log 改成 logger.info,最后报告涉及的文件数量。
howto.when: 当你要求按代码形状查找或批量改写代码时触发,例如'找到所有空 catch 块'、'去掉所有 as any'、'把 require() 换成 import'等。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can search and rewrite code by its structure rather than plain text. It finds functions, calls, classes, etc. that share the same shape and batch-replaces them, e.g., turns every console.log into logger.info, then reports the number of affected files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to find or batch-rewrite code by shape, e.g., 'find all empty catch blocks', 'strip all as any', 'migrate require() to import', etc.

say_en.note: Shows preview first, applies after confirmation

say_en.text: Find all empty catch blocks and list locations
say_en.note: Returns matching files and line numbers

say_en.text: Replace all require() with import across the project
say_en.note: Previews first, then applies if multiple files
